subject: Installing INLA on Mac - invalid url destinations, R v 4.1.1

messages.author: 343471734e578798
messages.subject: Installing INLA on Mac - invalid url destinations, R v 4.1.1
parts:
I am using INLA for a project I'm working on and am trying to install INLA on my Mac and am unable to do so successfully. Below I've outlined steps I've taken. Any help is greatly appreciated.

1. Attempted to install both stable (1st) and test versions, as detailed here.
    a. Result from trying to install stable version:
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  download from 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib/INLA_21.02.23.tar.gz' failed
Warning in install.packages :
  download of package ‘INLA’ failed
   
    b. Result from trying to install testing version:
Warning in install.packages :
  downloaded length 19135737 != reported length 65869718
Warning in install.packages :
  URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/4.1/INLA_21.10.03.tgz': Timeout of 60 seconds was reached
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  download from 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/4.1/INLA_21.10.03.tgz' failed
Warning in install.packages :
  download of package ‘INLA’ failed

2. Attempted to install using devtools as follows:

library("devtools")
devtools::install_github(repo = "https://github.com/hrue/r-inla", ref = "stable", subdir = "rinla", build = FALSE)

      I did not get any error message upon running the devtools install, however when I tested the install as detailed in the reference link in point 1, I received a program crash notice as follows:

/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 123: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 129: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: No such file or directory
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run: line 129: exec: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.1/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: cannot execute: No such file or directory
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.


Information about my OS and R environment:
  • R version 4.1.1 (2021-08-10)
  • Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin17.0 (64-bit)
  • Running under: macOS Big Sur 11.5.2
Any help resolving this is greatly appreciated!
